requirements: For all eight relative manifest collections, resolve against the explicit module base and verify recorded SHA BEFORE adding to copy plan; missing or ambiguous files fail closed.
Preserve computed negative fixture files and full generated source/initialization text, not only successful bundles; derive synthetic *.cjs.native-profile.mjs IDs back to physical *.cjs.

Archive external indexed HTTP/storage TEXT under exact authenticated prefixes, including .jsonl; generated engines/components/tool binaries remain SHA-validated references unless one of five explicit native source binary assets.
Copy actual official-wash project config, isolated empty user config, full log and canonical host result; per-run duplicate may be a validated same-SHA reference.

Preserve legal custom application export WIT (late api/inspectResult). Only imported HOST interfaces are restricted to selected standard WASI; do not reject a custom export namespace as a host service.
Allowlist selected stream-web candidate/iteration/dataview checkers and oracles and single protected new-policy-pins.json; never recursively copy candidate/private/timing trees.
Historical v7 m0.1, v10 m0.8/Events-OFF and older optional-OFF controls require exact engine/metadata/source receipt validation or an authenticated parent chain; they are not current fourth engines.
All text copied into a stage must be rehashed against its source and plan after the final copy, immediately before atomic rename; no silent source_file omission for recorded required inputs.

validatedReferenceOnlyHistory.policy: All listed historical engine bytes, sidecar SHA and native source receipts independently rehashed read-only. No deep copy of old private/source or binary trees; retain reports/source vectors and authenticate parent chain; not additional current engines.

exclusions: node_modules tree except selected BufferList source/package/LICENSE
generated .wasm/.cwasm and host executables except five explicit required native source assets
production-candidate-m0.11/** and production-candidate-m0.11-v2/** except separately pinned proposal-provenance text
single-project*/timing*/matched*/bench*/optimization*/weval-experiment*/utf8-direct*/text-decoder-private/** unless a specific actual consumed source is explicitly admitted
unselected Blob/zlib/stream/AsyncLocalStorage prototype trees; no reference grants recursion

centrallyHandledNativeFreeze.rule: Existing explicit native/Componentize source and freeze top-level config handlers cover these HTTP index entries; no duplicate external list needed

generatedSourceRules: Preserve emitted *.wit, package.json, runner logs, progress/mismatch JSON and original failed storage/import attempts; binary hashes remain references
criticalWitnessPrefixes.sourceQueueRule: Require exact per-record SHA and explicit module base; normalize synthetic CJS ids; metadata path strings do not grant recursive traversal
